recipes.label: How to Face the Enemy?
recipes.startdescription:
True strength does not come in a single form, nor does the power to win reside in just one reality.

[Invest aspects meeting any of the enemy’s thresholds to launch an attack. Investing at least 5 ranks higher than the corresponding threshold guarantees a successful strike.]

recipes.label: Nowhere to Be Found?
recipes.startdescription:
I know this enemy is nearby—yet I need more information to devise a strategy.

[You cannot attack an enemy in hiding. Place the hidden enemy in the exploration slot to attempt to reveal it.]

recipes.label: Finality：Force
recipes.startdescription: I shall command them with the language of force—they have no right to defy, and they shall meet their end.

recipes.label: Finality：Revolution
recipes.startdescription: There will be a revolution, but the flame of rebirth needs kindling. They shall be the fuel.

recipes.label: Finality：Torment
recipes.startdescription: Torment and pleasure share the same pinnacle. Today I shall bring torment, and they shall embrace it as if it were sweetness.

recipes.label: Finality：Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: The struggle to endure is a march, and I will absolutely, absolutely, absolutely never stop.

recipes.label: Finality：Opening
recipes.startdescription: The paths of Knock lead everywhere and reach all realms; yet the roads they tread can only descend.

recipes.label: Finality：Ruthlessness
recipes.startdescription: There is no place for shadow, and no place for mercy. Under the cold witness of the light, I shall deliver certain death.

recipes.label: Finality：Chaos
recipes.startdescription: The ultimate strategy is to have no strategy at all. The path is unpredictable, and precisely because of that, I can arrive at the inevitable outcome.

recipes.label: Finality：Silence
recipes.startdescription: It ends here, silent and solemn, beautiful as the setting sun in snow.

recipes.label: Tactics：Force
recipes.startdescription: Speech was the weapon that won the first war. And the language of force speaks louder than words.

recipes.label: Tactics：Revolution
recipes.startdescription: Arms as the hammer, battlefield as the anvil—here shall I kindle the fires of change.

recipes.label: Tactics：Torment
recipes.startdescription: All living things yield to the lure of the Grail, yet its essence is torment. I shall prove it.

recipes.label: Tactics：Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: The shadow of war is a contest of survival, and my survival will not end today.

recipes.label: Tactics：Opening
recipes.startdescription: Nothing can truly be sealed shut. Their lives shall cross the threshold and spill outward.

recipes.label: Tactics：Ruthlessness
recipes.startdescription: The Glory casts an indifferent gaze upon this place, and in its turn I shall deliver a judgment equally devoid of mercy.

recipes.label: Tactics：Chaos
recipes.startdescription: Yearning is the spark that sets the soul ablaze, yet it may just as easily spiral into chaos. They will rush into the flames.

recipes.label: Tactics：Silence
recipes.startdescription: Words end here. Even in silence there is power—a power that brings an end.

recipes.label: Victory!
recipes.startdescription:
In the face of reality‑overriding power, all defenses and resistance seem feeble.

[This attack ignores all enemy traits!]

recipes.label: Attack Missed!
recipes.startdescription: Unexpected setbacks always arise. This attack failed to take effect, and pulling back safely will require a little extra time—

recipes.comments: 攻击命中，链接攻击结果。

recipes.label: Attack Blocked!
recipes.startdescription: The special form of this being has deflected what should have been a fatal strike… but there will not be a second chance.

recipes.label: Reality Distortion!
recipes.startdescription: A shield of protection around this being has deflected the attack that should have struck true. Perhaps I should wield a weapon of power.

recipes.label: Enemy Still Alive?
recipes.startdescription: I've struck with everything I have, yet the enemy remains standing... This can only be attributed to its astonishing resilience.

recipes.label: Enemy Still Alive
recipes.startdescription: I need to try once more to ensure the enemy is completely destroyed.

recipes.label: Victory!
recipes.startdescription: Every act of destruction paves the way for renewed creation; every victory becomes fuel for greater glory.

recipes.label: The Void Boils!
recipes.startdescription:
A lethal force breaks free from its shackles, becoming a whirlpool of annihilation—

[Allies, tools, or abilities drawn into it enter cooldown. Materials and non‑immortal allies are consumed.]
recipes.description: After devouring enough reality, the hollow vortex finally satiates. Let us pray it is not invoked again.
